title: acSweep
body:
## acSweep

Computes the small-signal phasor response of a linear RLC network to one grounded sinusoidal source at evenly spaced frequencies. results.csv gives, per probe, real and imaginary parts and magnitude in volts and phase in degrees, alongside circuit-summary.json and circuit.cir; every value is checked against an independent complex nodal solution. Choose it for filter cut-offs, resonance and gain versus frequency; inductors are only allowed in this analysis.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- start and stop are in hertz with linear (not logarithmic) spacing; use enough points to resolve narrow resonances.
- Phase uses the exp(+j*omega*t) convention, so a lagging output has negative phase.
- Loops made only of inductors, an inductor directly across the source, and singular or ill-conditioned networks at any sample frequency are rejected; there is no mutual coupling.

Native binding: `ngspice ac lin`. Output kind: `["table"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `circuit` | The circuit, written inline: one ideal voltage source between ground (node "0") and the source node, 1 to 64 resistors, up to 64 capacitors, up to 64 uncoupled inductors (acSweep only) and the nodes to publish. At most 16 non-ground nodes; no netlist, device model or subcircuit can be imported. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"default":"in"},"resistors":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":64,"required":true,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"resistance":{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0,"required":true}}}},"capacitors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"capacitance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-12,"maximum":1,"required":true}}}},"probes":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"maxItems":15,"uniqueItems":true,"items":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32},"default":["out"]},"inductors":{"type":"array","maxItems":64,"default":[],"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"a":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"b":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":32,"required":true},"inductance":{"type":"number","minimum":1e-09,"maximum":1000.0,"required":true}}}}}}` | **required** |
| `start` | DC start is signed source volts (default 0); AC start is positive frequency Hz (default 1). stop must exceed start. rcStep always starts at zero seconds. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0}` | `1` |
| `stop` | DC stop is source volts (default 5), AC stop is positive Hz (default 10000), RC stop is seconds (default 0.005). RC duration must be 0.01–20 R*C time constants. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0.001,"maximum":1000000000.0}` | `10000` |
| `points` | Number of evenly spaced samples including endpoints: 2–512 for DC/RC, 3–512 for AC; default 101. Finite samples cannot prove a continuous response envelope. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3,"maximum":512}` | `101` |
| `amplitude` | Source voltage for acSweep and rcStep, -1000 to 1000 V, and must be nonzero; dcSweep uses start and stop instead. In acSweep it is the phasor amplitude (gainMagnitude divides by its absolute value); in rcStep it is the height of the step. | `{"type":"number","minimum":-1000,"maximum":1000}` | `1` |
